entities.summary: Casal Vasco is a small village in Portugal. It belongs to the municipality of Fornos de Algodres, district of Guarda. It's also located in the former region of Beira Alta. The population in 2011 was 227, in an area of 6.73 km2. Includes the place of Ramirão and the Quinta das Moitas. Casal Vasco was a freguesia of Portugal in Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
